html: Started react-agent-from-scratch: a ReAct agent in plain Python with a provider-agnostic LLM wrapper (work in progress).
Published a fully local PDF RAG system (FAISS, Ollama) with a retrieval evaluation — rag-qa-system on GitHub.
Wrapped up project-based freelance work as a Machine Learning Engineer: RAG pipelines, MCP-based AI agents and API-served AI pipelines for industrial clients.
Wrapped up an AI Engineer role at Goodfolio (London, remote), building consent-based data pipelines and Neo4j-backed semantic search for LLM applications.
Completed an MSc in Computer Science — Data Mining at IASBS, Zanjan, with a thesis on scoring augmented sentences using an autoencoder and Siamese BERT.
